notes: Fixed prompt set for comparing agent 3D tools. Each tool gets the same model, the same prompt text and the same time/turn budget. Outputs are judged blind from identical renders.

prompts.prompt: A friendly goblin merchant with big pointed ears, a round belly and a backpack. Game-ready, stylized.
A small cartoon knight in plate armor with a helmet visor, holding a sword in the right hand.
A chubby cat sitting upright with its tail wrapped around its paws.
A stylized stegosaurus with back plates and a spiked tail that can walk.
A round owl with big eyes, ear tufts and folded wings, perched on a branch.
A glowing jellyfish with a dome bell and trailing tentacles that pulses.
A toy pickup truck with an open cargo bed, headlights and wheels that turn.
A small propeller airplane with a spinning propeller.
A chunky pirate ship with a hull, two masts and sails.
A striped lighthouse on a rock with a glowing lamp room.
A medieval windmill with a stone base, wooden cap and four sails that rotate.
A double-bladed battle axe with a wrapped wooden handle.
A wizard staff with a crooked top holding a glowing orb, with sparkles around the orb.
A campfire: crossed logs in a ring of stones, with fire and a little smoke.
A three-legged wooden stool with a round seat.
A saguaro cactus with two arms in a terracotta pot.
A stylized pine tree with stacked layers of branches.
A four-legged robot dog with an antenna and glowing eyes that walks.
An open treasure chest overflowing with gold coins.
A cartoon rocket with fins and a round window, with a smoke trail from its engine.
